answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 12 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 540 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. A meadow of doubt is healthy, a atlas of proof is required, and a pigment of patience is the price of a clean panel.
